package com.farmingcontract.farming;

import java.awt.Color;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import net.runelite.client.ui.ColorScheme;

@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Getter
public enum CropState
{
	HARVESTABLE(ColorScheme.PROGRESS_COMPLETE_COLOR),
	GROWING(ColorScheme.PROGRESS_COMPLETE_COLOR),
	DISEASED(ColorScheme.PROGRESS_INPROGRESS_COLOR),
	DEAD(ColorScheme.PROGRESS_ERROR_COLOR),
	EMPTY(ColorScheme.MEDIUM_GRAY_COLOR),
	FILLING(ColorScheme.PROGRESS_INPROGRESS_COLOR);

	private final Color color;
}

package com.farmingcontract.data; import com.farmingcontract.farming.Produce; import java.util.Collections; import java.util.EnumSet; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; import java.util.Set; import javax.annotation.Nullable; import lombok.Getter; import net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID; /** * Every crop Guildmaster Jane can assign as a Farming Guild contract, with the patch it grows in, * the seed or sapling required, and the crop-specific gardener protection payment. * *

Note that herb and flower crops cannot be protected at any price, and poison ivy * cannot become diseased, so those carry {@link ProtectionPayment#NONE}. */ @Getter public enum ContractCrop { // ItemID.ONION, "Onions"), EnumSet.of(ContractTier.EASY)), TOMATO(Produce.TOMATO, PatchType.ALLOTMENT, ItemID.TOMATO_SEED, "Tomato seed", ProtectionPayment.sacks(ItemID.SACK_CABBAGE_10, "Sack of cabbages", 2, ItemID.CABBAGE, "Cabbages"), EnumSet.of(ContractTier.EASY)), SWEETCORN(Produce.SWEETCORN, PatchType.ALLOTMENT, ItemID.SWEETCORN_SEED, "Sweetcorn seed", ProtectionPayment.loose(ItemID.DRAGONFRUIT, "Dragonfruit", 6), EnumSet.of(ContractTier.HARD)); private static final Map BY_PRODUCE; private static final Map BY_CONTRACT_NAME; static { Map byProduce = new HashMap<>(); Map byName = new HashMap<>(); for (ContractCrop crop : values()) { byProduce.put(crop.produce, crop); byName.put(crop.produce.getContractName().toLowerCase(), crop); } BY_PRODUCE = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byProduce); BY_CONTRACT_NAME = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byName); } private final Produce produce; private final PatchType patchType; /** * The seed or sapling the player must plant. For trees, fruit trees, celastrus and redwood * this is the sapling, not the raw seed. */ private final int seedItemId; private final String seedName; private final ProtectionPayment protection; private final Set tiers; ContractCrop(Produce produce, PatchType patchType, int seedItemId, String seedName, ProtectionPayment protection, Set tiers) { this.produce = produce; this.patchType = patchType; this.seedItemId = seedItemId; this.seedName = seedName; this.protection = protection; this.tiers = Collections.unmodifiableSet(tiers); } /** * The name Jane uses for this contract, e.g. "Maple tree". */ public String getContractName() { return produce.getContractName(); } /** * How many seeds or saplings one planting needs. */ public int getSeedQuantity() { return patchType.getPlantQuantity(); } /** * The harvested produce item, used for the panel's crop icon. */ public int getProduceItemId() { return produce.getItemID(); } @Nullable public static ContractCrop forProduce(@Nullable Produce produce) { return produce == null ? null : BY_PRODUCE.get(produce); } /** * Resolve a contract name as spoken by Guildmaster Jane, case-insensitively. */ @Nullable public static ContractCrop forContractName(@Nullable String name) { return name == null ? null : BY_CONTRACT_NAME.get(name.trim().toLowerCase()); } }
